'''G6-M2''' was a [[Shopkeeper droid/Legends|shopkeeper droid]] served the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. It was stationed aboard the ''[[Black Talon]]'', a [[Transport/Legends|transport]] in service to the [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]], when it [[Attack on the Brentaal Star|attacked]] the Republic [[Warship/Legends|warship]] ''[[Brentaal Star]]''. During the attack, the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] sold [[Stimulant/Legends|stimulants]] and [[Medpac/Legends|medpacs]] to Imperial personnel.<ref name="SWTOR" />
